summary: Rewrote load_subagents() in orchestrator/src/utils/subagents.py to be metadata-driven: reads the subagents list from the ledger persona YAML via find_ledger_yaml_for_stage/_extract_yaml_list, resolves description from standalone persona YAML, and system_prompt from standalone deep-agents file. The name field is now the kebab-case slug itself.
Removed STAGE_SUBAGENT_FILES dict entirely from orchestrator/src/config.py.

Rewrote orchestrator/tests/test_subagents.py with fixture-based tests covering: happy-path structure, kebab-case names, description/system_prompt sources, no-subagents cases (developer stage, missing key, unknown stage), cache hit/clear, missing standalone YAML FileNotFoundError, missing deep-agents FileNotFoundError, missing description ValueError, plus integration tests against the real workspace confirming pm returns 4 specs.

Added a narrow try/except guard around find_ledger_yaml_for_stage() in load_subagents() to return [] gracefully when the manifest is inaccessible (needed for test fixtures that don't set up a full workspace), while still propagating FileNotFoundError from slug file resolution.
All 961 orchestrator tests pass (19 new test_subagents + 942 pre-existing).

comments.note: The try/except guard around find_ledger_yaml_for_stage() in load_subagents() is a pragmatic compatibility shim for test fixtures. The long-term improvement would be for test_streaming_capture.py (and similar) to include a minimal shared/workflow-manifest.json in their fixture workspaces so the guard is never triggered by real-workspace calls.

The _CACHE type annotation changed from dict[tuple[str,str], str] to dict[tuple[str,str], tuple[str,str]]. The cache now stores (description, system_prompt) tuples rather than bare content strings, which is cleaner and avoids a secondary description lookup on cache hit.

subagents.py imports _extract_yaml_list and _extract_yaml_scalar from persona_models.py using their underscore-prefixed names. These are module-private by convention but not truly private in Python. If persona_models.py ever adds a public re-export of these helpers, the import in subagents.py should be updated to use the public name.

comments.note: The OSError guard around find_ledger_yaml_for_stage() silently returns [] on any file-system error during manifest lookup. For production observability, a warning-level log is already emitted (log.debug call in subagents.py). Acceptable as-is; acknowledged by Developer in implementation notes.

The module-level _CACHE persists across the process lifetime and is keyed by (stage, slug). If persona files are modified while the orchestrator is running, the cache will serve stale content. This is intentional and documented in the module docstring — no action needed.
